text.text_excerpt: For my experience, the place was great. We came with a big party (14 people) and they were able to accommodate us. Their one requisite was we had to order at least 4 hookahs, but for a party of 14 that was A OK with us. It was the best hookah I've ever smoked. And I'm not a smoker, so I can't be viewed as an elite judge of smokes, but this hookah had me and my party on another planet lol. We had a great time. A few ordered drinks and food and there were no complaints. Our servers were very nice too. I plan to come back whenever me and my crew decide to do another smoke session night.

This is my go to spot for hookah. The hookah is great, the service is just okay. I find that the waiting staff tends to forget about you, they don't check on their tables often, so you're left looking for your waiter. The food is delicious and drinks are okay... a bit over priced. But if you're looking for a nice mid city spot to hang out with friends, some hookah and vibe I would recommend this place. I ordered the grilled shrimp plate with hummus instead of rice, and a side of tzatziki sauce to dip my grilled shrimp in... the meal was delicious!

Went there for hookah, we were told to pick a table, and we chose one that wasn't clean but we liked it, when the waiter showed up, we thought that she will clean it, but no, she took our order and brought it without cleaning the table that has bread crumbs from the previous customer, so we had to ask her to clean it for us. Their service is good but may be towards the lazy side. Our hookah was great and they were attentive on getting more charcoal. The ambiance is like typical middle eastern coffee shops, just basic.
